sermon.title: Holy Spirit Growth
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In the fourth Holy Spirit session, Pastor David G. Kincer shows that John and Jesus both had to grow strong in spirit after the initial filling. He explains the five ministry gifts of Ephesians 4 for equipping and maturing the saints, warns that groups convert you to their doctrine while the Spirit conforms you to Christ, and shows Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit after passing his tests.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Caption name fixes: Corban, Chuck Smith, Robert Schuller, Joel Osteen, Benny Hinn, Tyre and Sidon. He cites Luke 4:22 for the brothers’ names (Mark 6:3/Matthew 13:55) and “Luke 6” for “the power of the Lord was present to heal” (Luke 5:17); “I came down from heaven” is John 6:42. Unchecked: only one in three in charismatic/Pentecostal churches speak in tongues. Sensitive content kept as spoken: Muslims/Muhammad’s angel called stupid, Hindu reincarnation and river bathing, Catholics “lying” about Mary, denominations named, TV preachers named, presidential election.

faqs.question: Is a baby in the womb a human being?
faqs.answer: He says yes—John leaped for joy at six months; they are human beings.

faqs.question: What is grace?
faqs.answer: More than favor—it is God’s empowerment and involvement in our life.

faqs.question: What is religion?
faqs.answer: When people add their own opinion and doctrine; otherwise the body of Christ is a living organism.

faqs.question: What is the office of a teacher?
faqs.answer: One who shoots the arrow and hits the bullseye so you leave with clear understanding.

faqs.question: If Jesus’ body is in heaven, can he appear on earth?
faqs.answer: Yes—he appeared to Paul on the road to Damascus; he is God and can be anywhere.

faqs.question: Why did he end up in an independent church?
faqs.answer: They let him hold his mistaken doctrines until the Holy Ghost opened his eyes, without ostracizing him.

faqs.question: Why might believers lack the Spirit’s power?
faqs.answer: He says we may not have passed the tests—God can’t trust us to handle it.

faqs.question: Did Jesus advertise?
faqs.answer: No—no billboards, radio or TV; people came because of the word taught by the power of the Spirit.

faqs.question: Did Mary have other children?
faqs.answer: He says yes—Jesus had brothers and sisters, and the Catholic teaching otherwise is wrong.

faqs.question: What does “offended” mean there?
faqs.answer: Rejecting or deserting Jesus, not hurt feelings.
